offence_note: Drug offence with forfeiture of real property under CDSA
sentence_quote: The Court of Appeal upheld the conditional sentence but set aside the fine and the victim surcharge.
note: SCC allowed appeal and set aside forfeiture order; sentencing details only from summary; offence type inferred from CDSA.

offence_note: Break and enter to commit sexual assault; sexual assault
sentence_quote: I would affirm the designation of SWP as a long-term offender but substitute an LTSO of five years for that of ten years.
systemic_quote: He has lifelong cognitive deficits and has suffered many of the disadvantages that are experienced by Aboriginal offenders in Canada.
note: Four years concurrent on each charge; LTSO reduced from 10 to 5 years; offender was 16 at offence, sentenced as adult.

offence_note: Sexual interference and uttering threats against step-granddaughter
sentence_quote: I sentence you to six years in jail on count 1 (sexual interference), and one year concurrent on count two (uttering threats).
note: Offender refused to acknowledge responsibility; no credit for remorse.

offence_note: Common assault in domestic relationship over four days
sentence_quote: Mr. Delgren was sentenced to a conditional discharge with two years of probation.
systemic_quote: The mitigating factors were that Mr. Delgren had been compliant with his bail conditions for over a year, was of aboriginal heritage, and was willing to accept probationary terms aimed at his rehabilitation and redirection.
note: Crown sentence appeal dismissed; probation includes curfew and 50 hours community service.

offence_note: Aggravated assault with knife; possession of drugs
sentence_quote: In the result, we reduce the sentence on the aggravated assault charge to 12 months
note: Reduced from two years less a day; victim surcharge deleted; probation of two years stands.

offence_note: Sexual assault of sleeping friend by 15-year-old
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal and substitute a sentence of probation.
note: Youth custody and supervision order replaced with probation; probation length not shown.

sentence_quote: I find that the sentence imposed was excessive and that a conditional sentence would best reflect the overall principles of sentencing.
note: Six-month jail sentence set aside; conditional sentence terms left to later submissions; DNA order made.

sentence_quote: On the count of manslaughter in the death of David Delaney, I sentence you to ten years imprisonment.
note: Consecutive to robbery sentence already being served; credit 208 days at 1.5:1.
